curl -s http://127.0.0.1:35795/color.png -o /tmp/c.png && python3 -c "
import zlib,struct
d=open('/tmp/c.png','rb').read()
i=8;idat=b'';hdr=None
while i<len(d):
  l=struct.unpack('>I',d[i:i+4])[0];t=d[i+4:i+8];c=d[i+8:i+8+l]
  if t==b'IHDR':hdr=struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',c)
  if t==b'IDAT':idat+=c
  i+=12+l
print(hdr);r=zlib.decompress(idat);print(r[:16].hex(), set(r[1:hdr[0]*3+1]))
"
